levels.means: Funds may be at risk, or the whole platform is down
levels.examples: Hack, all withdrawals halted, exchange offline

levels.means: One core service is down or badly delayed
levels.examples: INR deposits delayed, one network's withdrawals stuck, login failing, orders not placing
One coin's deposits slow, chart glitch, slow KYC

levels.note: Announce 24 hours before; post at start and end

rules.detail: Post a short holding message within 15 minutes, even if the cause is unknown. Silence lets rumours on X and in the group set the story.

rules.rule: Lead with fund safety, but only if it is true
rules.detail: The first line answers 'is my money safe?'. Binance opened every hack update with 'funds are safe, we will cover all losses'.

rules.rule: Never deny before you have checked
rules.detail: Say 'we are checking' instead. CoinDCX's CEO called a breach report a 'false alarm', then confirmed a $16M loss days later.

rules.rule: Say exactly what is off and what still works
rules.detail: 'Withdrawals paused; trading, deposits and balances unaffected' stops most panic questions.

rules.rule: Give the time of the next update, then keep it
rules.detail: 'Next update by 14:30 IST', and post at 14:30 even if nothing changed.

rules.rule: One message, every channel, same minute
rules.detail: Telegram announcement, pinned group post, X, app banner. During its hack, Binance's key updates came on X first.

rules.rule: Answer complaints; never delete or ban them
rules.detail: Remove only scams and fake admins. ZebPay users reported complaints deleted and themselves blocked, which became a news story.
In India most group complaints come in Hinglish or Hindi; reply in the same register.
A resolved post, a plain-language cause, compensation and how to claim it, and a dated post-mortem. Binance paid about $283M within two days after the Oct 2025 crash.

timeline.do: Holding message on Telegram announcement, X and app banner; pin it in the group. Say what is affected, fund safety (or 'checking'), next update time.
Update with what works and what doesn't, any workaround, ETA if known. Admins answer in the group with the scripts. Post a scam warning.
Post at the promised time even with no change. Share progress (e.g. '8 of 15 networks back').
Resolved post on every channel: what's back, when pending items will clear, how to raise a ticket. Unpin the incident post.
Plain-language cause, impact, compensation and how to claim, what changed, dated full report.

roles.owns: Confirms facts and approves every public message
Writes and posts announcements at the same minute everywhere
roles.channel: Telegram announcement, X, app banner, email (S1)

roles.owns: Pin posts, answer with scripts, remove scams, escalate tickets
Same wording in ticket replies; tag incident tickets
S1 only: a personal post after the first official message, never before facts are confirmed

templates.en: We're aware some users can't [withdraw INR / place orders] right now. Our team is on it. [Your funds are safe / We're checking and will confirm by HH:MM]. [Trading and balances are not affected]. Next update by [HH:MM IST].
templates.hinglish: Kuch users ko abhi [INR withdrawal / order place karne] mein dikkat aa rahi hai. Hamari team is par kaam kar rahi hai. [Aapke funds safe hain / Hum check kar rahe hain, HH:MM tak confirm karenge]. Agla update [HH:MM] tak.

templates.en: Update [HH:MM IST]: [what we found, one line]. Working now: [services]. Still paused: [services]. Expected fix: [ETA, or 'ETA by HH:MM']. Next update by [HH:MM IST].
templates.hinglish: Update [HH:MM]: [kya pata chala]. Abhi chal raha hai: [services]. Abhi band hai: [services]. Expected fix: [ETA]. Agla update [HH:MM] tak.

templates.en: Resolved [HH:MM IST]: [service] is working normally. Pending [withdrawals] will process within [X hours]. If something still looks wrong, raise a ticket in the app. No admin will DM you first. Thank you for your patience.
templates.hinglish: Resolved [HH:MM]: [service] ab normal chal raha hai. Pending [withdrawals] [X ghante] mein process ho jayenge. Agar abhi bhi dikkat ho, app mein ticket raise karein. Koi admin aapko pehle DM nahi karega. Dhanyavaad.

templates.en: What happened on [date]: [cause, one sentence]. Impact: [who, what, how long]. Compensation: [what + how to claim by date, or why none]. What we changed: [1–2 fixes]. Full report: [link or date].
templates.hinglish: [Date] ko kya hua: [cause]. Asar: [kis par, kitni der]. Compensation: [kya milega + kaise claim karein]. Humne kya badla: [fixes]. Poori report: [link / date].

templates.en: Scheduled maintenance: [service] on [date], [HH:MM]–[HH:MM IST] (about [duration]). [Deposits/withdrawals] pause 5 minutes before. Trading [is / is not] affected. We'll post here when it's done.
templates.hinglish: Scheduled maintenance: [service], [date] ko [HH:MM]–[HH:MM] tak (lagbhag [duration]). [Deposits/withdrawals] 5 minute pehle ruk jayenge. Trading [par asar nahi / band rahegi]. Khatam hone par yahin update denge.

scripts.en: Yes. Balances are safe and not affected; only [service] is paused. The pinned post has every update.
scripts.hinglish: Haan, aapka balance safe hai. Sirf [service] abhi ruki hai. Saare updates pinned post mein hain.
scripts.note: Only if confirmed. Otherwise: 'We're checking now and will confirm by HH:MM.'

scripts.en: We expect [ETA] / we'll share an ETA by [HH:MM]. The pinned post is updated every 30 minutes.
scripts.hinglish: [ETA] tak expected hai / [HH:MM] tak ETA batayenge. Pinned post har 30 minute update hota hai.

scripts.en: It's queued, not lost. It will process automatically when [service] is back. If it hasn't arrived [X hours] after the resolved post, raise a ticket with your TxID.
scripts.hinglish: Aapka transaction queue mein hai, lost nahi hua. [Service] wapas aate hi apne aap process ho jayega. Resolved post ke [X ghante] baad bhi na aaye to TxID ke saath ticket raise karein.

scripts.q: Is this a scam? Are you running away?
scripts.en: No. [What happened, what is affected]. We'll publish a full report by [date].
scripts.hinglish: Nahi. [Kya hua, kya affected hai]. Poori report [date] tak publish karenge.

scripts.en: If you lost money because of our issue (failed orders, forced liquidation during the downtime), claim through [form/ticket] by [date]. Normal market moves aren't covered.
scripts.hinglish: Agar hamari dikkat ki wajah se nuksaan hua (order fail, downtime mein liquidation), to [form/ticket] se [date] tak claim karein. Normal market movement cover nahi hota.

scripts.en: Sorry for the wait; ticket volume is high. Share your ticket number here and we'll escalate it. Never share your password or OTP.
scripts.hinglish: Wait ke liye sorry, abhi tickets bahut zyada hain. Apna ticket number yahan share karein, hum escalate karenge. Password ya OTP kabhi share na karein.

scripts.en: That's a scammer. Admins never DM first and never ask for passwords, OTPs or transfers. Please report and block them.
scripts.hinglish: Woh scammer hai. Admin kabhi pehle DM nahi karte, na password, OTP ya transfer maangte hain. Report aur block karein.

donts.example: CoinDCX's CEO called breach reports a 'false alarm' on X; the company confirmed a $16M loss days later (Oct 2026).
In both CoinDCX cases, on-chain investigators flagged the outflows before the exchange explained them.
Binance's first hack statements and the 48-hour ETA led on X and executives' posts (Oct 2026).
ZebPay users said their group complaints were deleted and they were blocked (2022).

donts.dont: Say 'reopened' when most of it is still off
donts.example: Binance announced withdrawals were back while most coins were still suspended (Nov 2026).

donts.dont: Promise a report without a date
donts.example: Binance's post-mortem and reserve proof were still pending two weeks after the hack.

donts.dont: Say 'no compensation' without a claim path
donts.example: Binance's 'no compensation for market losses' angered traders whose stop-losses failed (Oct 2025).
Every gap without a post fills the group with rumours and 'are you running away?' messages.

maintenance: Announce at least 24 hours before, then again 1 hour before.
Give exact start and end in IST and UTC, and the expected duration.
Name what pauses and what keeps working; pause 5 minutes before start.
Avoid Indian evening peak hours and big-news days (CPI, FOMC, major unlocks).
Post 'done' the moment it ends, and say if anything is delayed.

targets.metric: Customers complain → first admin reply in group
Downtime post on X → first exchange reply under it
